test_intent: Verifies that IsChannelOwnerAsync returns true when the message sender matches a channel administrator.
reason: Clean unit test at the correct seam. Verifies the positive path of channel owner detection by mocking GetChatAdministratorsAsync and asserting the boolean result. Channel owner check is a real production behavior used for allowing channel messages. Direct service call with mocked Telegram adapter, meaningful assertion, no external dependencies.

test_intent: Verifies that IsChannelOwnerAsync returns false when the message sender does not match any channel administrator.
reason: Clean unit test at the correct seam. Verifies the negative path of channel owner detection with a different user ID in the administrators list. Complements the positive case. Meaningful boolean assertion, mocked dependencies, no external calls.

test_intent: Verifies that ShouldAllowChannelMessageAsync returns true when the channel owner sends a message.
reason: Tests the core channel moderation decision: channel owners should be allowed to post. Mocks both GetChatAdministratorsAsync and GetChatAsync, asserts meaningful boolean result. This is a real bot contract that prevents false bans of legitimate channel messages.

test_intent: Verifies that ShouldAllowChannelMessageAsync returns true for automatic forward messages from linked channel discussions.
reason: Tests the IsAutomaticForward fast path for linked channel discussions. These are system-generated forwards that should always be allowed regardless of channel ownership. Clean assertion on boolean result, mocks only GetChatAsync. Protects against a regression where legitimate discussion forwards are blocked.

test_intent: Verifies that ShouldAllowChannelMessageAsync returns false when the channel owner is not recognized.
reason: Tests the negative path for channel message moderation: unknown channels should not be automatically allowed. Uses different user ID (456) in administrators to simulate unrecognized channel. Meaningful boolean assertion, complements the positive cases. Protects against a regression where all channel messages are allowed without verification.
